established_exploration_scenarios.title: Lunar/Mars Exploration Habitat Atmosphere (0.57 atm / 34% O₂)
established_exploration_scenarios.scientific_rationale: NASA's Exploration Atmospheres architecture adopts 8.2 psia (56.5 kPa) and 34% oxygen for EVA transit. Reduced pressure increases gas diffusivity while elevated oxygen significantly accelerates flame spread and lowers ignition energy.
established_exploration_scenarios.empirical_gap_identified: Historical FLEX droplet tests evaluated 0.69 to 3.0 atm; zero droplet combustion experiments exist at 0.57 atm. Solid spread tests (Saffire) tested near-ambient or 1 atm.

proposed_experiment.title: Sub-Atmospheric Hyperoxic Droplet Burning & Extinction Test
proposed_experiment.facility: NASA Glenn Zero Gravity Research Facility (ZGF Drop Tower) / ISS CIR
proposed_experiment.expected_outcome: Quantify whether radiative extinction limits shift to smaller droplet diameters and determine if cool flame transitions persist at 0.57 atm.
proposed_experiment.disclaimer: Proposed follow-up experiment — formulated as an exploratory research proposal, not an established NASA flight mandate.

established_exploration_scenarios.title: High-Concentration CO₂ Quenching in Low Forced Convective Flows
established_exploration_scenarios.scientific_rationale: While droplet tests verified >30% CO₂ quenches isolated liquid droplets, the interaction between CO₂ extinguisher deployment and ventilation draft (5–20 cm/s) across porous solid fabrics in microgravity remains uncharacterized.
established_exploration_scenarios.empirical_gap_identified: BASS and Saffire investigated airflow spread, but rarely combined concurrent flow with high localized CO₂ extinguishing concentrations.

proposed_experiment.title: Microgravity Smoldering and Flame Quenching Under CO₂ Injection with Concurrent Draft
proposed_experiment.facility: SoFIE (Solid Fuel Ignition and Extinction) insert aboard CIR
proposed_experiment.expected_outcome: Determine whether localized CO₂ discharge extinguishes the flame or merely forces transition to low-oxygen subsurface smoldering.
proposed_experiment.disclaimer: Proposed follow-up experiment — formulated as an exploratory research proposal, not an established NASA flight mandate.

established_exploration_scenarios.title: Low-Gravity Partial Buoyancy Regimes (Lunar 0.16g and Martian 0.38g)
established_exploration_scenarios.scientific_rationale: Terrestrial 1g creates dominant upward buoyancy. 0g eliminates buoyancy entirely. Partial gravities (Moon/Mars) exist in an unstable intermediate regime where buoyant flow is weak yet non-zero, potentially trapping toxic combustion products close to ignition surfaces.
established_exploration_scenarios.empirical_gap_identified: 99% of NASA Physical Sciences combustion trials were flown at 0g aboard the ISS or drop towers, with the remaining fraction tested in 1g. Fractional gravity data is almost non-existent in public archives.

proposed_experiment.title: Parabolic Flight / Centrifuge-Augmented Partial Gravity Flame Morphology Study
proposed_experiment.facility: Reduced Gravity Parabolic Aircraft (Lunar & Martian parabolic maneuvers)
proposed_experiment.expected_outcome: Measure transition Reynolds and Grashof numbers where flame transitions from spherical symmetry to buoyant plume.
proposed_experiment.disclaimer: Proposed follow-up experiment — formulated as an exploratory research proposal, not an established NASA flight mandate.
